entries.022aa141e5821237: This business supplies dismantling equipment for recycling solar panels to industrial waste operators in Japan and overseas, among others. It sells 3 types of equipment: a frame and J-Box separator, which separates the aluminum frame from the junction box; a glass separator, which separates the cell sheet from the cover glass using the patented 'hot knife separation method'; and an EVA scraper, which removes remaining EVA using the patented 'brush scraping method'. Revenue for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥228 million.
entries.0e82bb5ffb674f33: This business sells consumable parts and spare parts for failures or deterioration of the equipment sold, for solar cell manufacturing equipment, solar panel recycling equipment, and FA equipment. Its main customers are solar cell manufacturers in the United States. Revenue for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥971 million.

entries.5638522fcc9cd7db: This is a service business that combines inspection services for solar power plants, reuse and recycling of solar panels, and the plant factory business. Inspections cover power plants nationwide through the inspection network 'Solar Wellness,' which the company leads, and the company also handles the resale of reused discharged panels and intermediate treatment at the Matsuyama Plant. In plant factories, the company sells lettuce and other produce grown with LEDs. Revenue for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥141 million.

entries.badca6059168ff36: This business mainly provides solar cell manufacturers in the United States with various FA equipment, including electrode formation equipment, welding equipment, vacuum laminators, inspection equipment, and assembly and transfer equipment, for manufacturing high-performance, high-efficiency solar panels. It also supplies equipment for next-generation solar cells, such as perovskite, to solar panel manufacturers in Japan and overseas. Revenue for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥7,159 million.
entries.cc80ffba2bd4a739: Drawing on vacuum, coating, bonding, inspection and measurement, handling, and transfer technologies accumulated in the solar cell industry, this business supplies FA equipment for automation and labor saving to various industries, including the automotive parts, electronic components, and industrial waste treatment industries. For the industrial waste treatment industry, it also supplies AI-equipped sorting machines, among others. Revenue for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥772 million.

entries.e8329cd756bd6c64: This is a single segment that manufactures and sells solar cell manufacturing equipment, solar panel recycling equipment, and various FA equipment, and provides inspection services for solar power plants, reuse and recycling of panels, and sales of vegetables from plant factories. Revenue for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥9,272 million, accounting for all consolidated revenue. On 1 September 2024, the Environment-Related Business Division was merged into the Equipment-Related Business Division to unify the divisions; however, there was no change to the business content itself. The company, its consolidated subsidiary NPC America Automation Inc., and its unconsolidated subsidiary NPC Korea Co., Ltd. make up the group, and its main sites are the head office in Taito-ku, Tokyo and the Matsuyama Plant in Matsuyama, Ehime Prefecture.
